purpose: Two metric fixes (yaw_drift physical correctness + eval anti-hang) to produce the COMPLETE Gate-C metric dataset (corrected yaw_drift + the still-missing dof_viol/base_pitch/base_height) on a run that won't stall between seeds.

harness_fixes.fix1_yaw_drift: Replaced abs(absolute base heading) accumulation with the body-frame yaw ANGULAR VELOCITY (base_ang_vel[0,2], rad/s -> deg/s). The iter-11 run showed yaw_drift=177.1 (FAIL vs threshold 15) which was physically inconsistent with good vx tracking (0.24) and low lateral drift (0.37) -> it was a metric defect (accumulating raw heading without wraparound/baseline), same pattern as the jp_err reference-mismatch. The corrected metric measures |yaw rate| in deg/s, matching the frozen task_spec 'yaw_drift (deg/s, mean |abs|)'.
harness_fixes.fix2_anti_hang: Replaced the single global step_cap with a PER-EPISODE step budget (ep_budget = 2*nfull + 50). If env[0] does not terminate within 2x nominal episode length, force-count it as a completed episode (timeout) so one stuck-but-not-terminated seed cannot loop forever. This resolves the TASK_049/059 eval-stuck-between-seeds issue (both hung for hours after 3/5 seeds).
